color.note: System colors and grays are the HIG's published RGB values (Color > Specifications), with the increased-contrast variants as extra themes. Semantic tokens mirror UIKit's dynamic colors (values are the commonly used UIKit defaults, not printed on the HIG page). Apple says not to hard-code these on native; on the web they are the closest stand-ins.

spacing.note: Two profiles. `desktop-*` = pointer + keyboard apps (macOS-style windows, 13px body). `mobile-*` = touch apps and mobile web (iOS-style, 17px body, 44px targets). HIG publishes only the 44pt hit target; every other value is a suggested web proportion. `space-*` is a shared 4px scale. Apply a profile with data-platform="desktop|mobile" (components read --hig-* variables mapped from these tokens).
